Name: (CP) More Aquarium Decor
Author: LonelySheepling
Description:
Inspired by:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23155]Put Batteries in Fish Tanks[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/45351277]BadNetCode[/url] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7984]
Aquarium Overhaul[/url]﻿ by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/24986819]Gervig91[/url]

[b]Info:[/b]
This mod adds 40 new aquarium decorations. 
Vanilla items that can now be added to fish tanks: 
[list]
[*]wood
[*]fiber
[*]moss
[*]green algae
[*]white algae
[*]driftwood
[*]spring onion
[*]coconut
[*]golden coconut
[*]chipped amphora
[*]soggy newspaper
[*]prehistoric skull
[*]prehistoric tibia
[*]fossilized skull
[*]fossilized spine
[*]nautilus fossil
[*]dried starfish
[*]mermaid's pendant
[*]prismatic shard
[*]dragon tooth
[*]golden relic
[*]sandstone
[*]helvite
[*]granite
[*]lunarite
[*]neptunite
[*]pyrite
[*]marble
[*]basalt
[*]mudstone
[*]ocean stone
[*]cinder shard
[*]fiddlehead fern
[*]battery pack
[*]sap
[*]radioactive ore
[*]rusty cog
[*]copper bar
[*]copper ingot
[*]gold bar
[/list]
[b]Mod conflicts:[/b]
Playing with this mod and another that edits the aquarium data to add sprites for the same items may cause issues but I haven't tested that
I'm not a professional mod maker, my knowledge is extremely limited. So just err on the side of caution when mixing similar mods with this one 

Note (9/17/25): This mod is compatible with the latest version of SVE
